comment: Live Google Sheets spreadsheet IDs for the SALE/DISPATCH registers by fiscal year. THREE DISTINCT SCHEMAS — Schema A (FY2026-27, 18-col, tab per month): InvoiceNo, Date, BillFrom, CustomerName, City, Destination, ItemCode, Color, Qty, MRP, SaleRate, TaxableValue, GROUP, STATION, STATE, STATE HEAD, MONTH. Schema B (FY2024-25 and FY2025-26, 11-col, tab per month, Sheet1=Combined): INVOICENO, DATE, BILLFROM, CUSTOMER, GROUP, CODE, COLOR, QTY, MRP, SALERATE, AMOUNT — no MONTH col; month from tab name (tabMonthLabel). Schema C (FY2023-24, 10-col, single Sheet1 tab): Customer, Item Code, MONTH, Quantity, Rate, Amount, GROUP, station, STATE, STATE HEAD A — NO INVOICE NO, NO COLOR. Schema C cannot be safely loaded via versionedSyncLines until a schema-aware identity key (that uses a deterministic per-row occurrence counter) is implemented; FY2023-24 is in REGISTER_SYNC_PAUSE. Verified row counts: FY2023-24=137619, FY2024-25=141201, FY2025-26=145613.
